Resolves #19580

The film's close now pans the hundred-thousand-row matrix by real diagonal strokes: a `grid-drag-scroll` cue drives three mousedown → mousemove → mouseup brackets from the pane's lower right, up and to the left at hand tempo (36 samples at 33 ms per stroke), and the grid's own drag-scroll (`Neo.grid.ScrollManager#dragScroll` through the `GridDragScroll` main-thread addon) carries the content with the hand on both axes — the rows keep crossing after the jump to the middle and the sparkline column at the right edge, the framework's OffscreenCanvas path that no take had ever shown, comes into the frame. The executor (`GestureDriver#executeGridDragScrollStep`) dispatches the raw event bracket the addon reads (the simulator's drive arms only Neo drags and refused the grid), escorts the film cursor along each stroke, waits for the addon's inertia tail to settle, and proves in its receipt that `scrollLeft` and `scrollTop` both moved in the dragged direction. The cue joins both cue vocabularies; the screenplay validates; the film witness asserts the receipt.

Rebased onto `dev` at b4b3737810 after #19581 (the reveal) merged: the strokes only make sense once the matrix is in front, and that is now the base.

Evidence: L3 (unit + headless e2e on the author's seat, own bridge) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2); AC-3 is the next take's frames. Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #15252.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit + e2e ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `fiveBeatFilm.spec` "validates and names only shipped operations and handled cues" (both vocabularies carry `grid-drag-scroll`) + the hand-tempo guard (the new walk at 33 ms × 36) — CI |
| AC-2 | `WorkstationFilmTourNL` auto-gates run: the cue's receipt `applied`, `strokes: 3`, `after.settled`, `travel.met` `{x: true, y: true}` with `expected = min(requested, room)` per axis, `observed ≥ expected − slack`, `expected.x ≥ 130` and `expected.y ≥ 50` (a column / a row of room) — Test Evidence; the receipt contract is the ticket's Contract Ledger |
| AC-3 | post-merge: the take's close frames show the rows moving and the sparkline column entering (#15252) — Post-Merge Validation |

## Deltas from ticket
- Review round 1: the receipt fails on an unsettled tail and on travel short of `min(requested, room)` less one sample per stroke of slack (`readGridScrollRoom`, `measureGridTravel`); the cursor moves with each dispatched sample instead of an independent timer; the ticket body carries the Contract Ledger, AC-2 reconciled to the three-stroke raw-event shape with the travel criterion, AC-3 explicitly deferred.
- The ticket named `driveDrag`; the simulator's drive refused the grid (`DRAG_NOT_ARMED` — it arms Neo drag sensors, and the grid's drag-scroll is a plain DOM listener), so the executor dispatches the raw bracket through the driver's `simulateEvent`, as the rail and showcase executors do.
- Three strokes instead of one: the pane is narrower than the matrix, so a single stroke cannot reach the canvas column; the hand returns to the anchor between strokes, as a person pans a map.

## Test Evidence
Round 1 head 5d24102b79 (Sophie's RA-1..3): `GestureDriver.spec` 54/54 — six new grid controls: the measured receipt, an unsettled tail refused with its proof, pixel-sized travel refused by name, a bounded axis met at its room, the failures by name, the cursor held at the anchor while the press's acknowledgement is pending and standing on every sample it escorted; `fiveBeatFilm.spec` + `TourController.spec` 23/23. `WorkstationFilmTourNL` headless: the full file 2/3 — the autoGates test failed on `film-reintegration[0]` ("native-return: native frame movement was refused", the window-frame move, not the grid cue; no grid error in the log) and passed 1/1 on its own re-run at the same head with the new travel assertions.

Round 0 head 79a3913695, headless on the author's seat (`NEO_NL_PORT` own bridge, `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set): `WorkstationFilmTourNL` 3/3 and `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` 5/5 at this head; the auto-gates run's close: scroll beat +0.41 s, the strokes 4.76 s, total `elapsedMs` 61711 (was 56197 without the strokes). The workstation unit folder 204/204.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] AC-3: the next take at the merged head — the close frames show the matrix rows crossing and the sparkline (canvas) column entering the frame; the receipt's `grid-drag-scroll` proof carries the scroll deltas (#15252).
